question: How is the goddess related to the sacred ritual diagram in form, essence, sovereignty, and worship?
premises: The goddess has the form of the ritual diagram.
The goddess consists of the ritual diagram.
The goddess is sovereign of and worshipped in the ritual diagram.
inference: The goddess fully pervades the ritual diagram as its form, substance, ruler, and object of worship.
plain_english: She has the form of the diagram, consists of the diagram, is the lady of the diagram, and is worshipped in the diagram.
